lens: Information and discoverability — narrow mobile viewport; simulated expertise/user lens
reason: The inspected public information architecture is coherent and restrained. The 390px homepage capture makes the student-led proposition and both audience actions legible, while its framed instrument, typography and hairlines express Precision Instrument consistently. Source tracing supports a client journey from services and pro-bono terms to an inquiry form with useful guidance, failure recovery and an email alternative. Student content explains eligibility, materials and individual evaluation without promising anonymous resume review. Canonical/social metadata and private noindex defaults are explicit. Dynamic case pages and generated social images consult the public release boundary; the supplied production fixture demonstrates publication and page withdrawal without rebuilding. However, information completeness has a small substantive gap, and local captures plus synthetic journeys cannot establish world-class task success or hosted release readiness. This is an independent AI source/capture assessment, not observed student/client behavior.

findings.evidence: Preparation tells applicants to ask current members about time commitment; the weekly-commitment FAQ lists activities but again says to ask during recruitment. The Join page renders these entries without a published expected load.
findings.userImpact: A student comparing commitments on a phone cannot assess schedule fit independently before applying; finding the named FAQ still leaves the actual planning question unanswered.
findings.suggestedFix: Obtain and publish a Board-approved current-cycle weekly range and required meeting expectations, dated by semester. If unsettled, state that explicitly and link directly to a contact route for this question; do not invent hours.

notVerified: No staging, deployment or hosted Clerk/Supabase/storage/email integration evidence exists. The inspected client journey test intercepts /api/contact with a synthetic 200 response; it does not prove board receipt or response timing.

No human task-success study, physical-device testing, assistive-technology session, Safari or Firefox evidence. Only the supplied homepage mobile captures were visually inspected; Join/contact mobile craft is supported by source and recorded overflow checks, not screenshots.

Real search indexing, social-platform cache invalidation and production canonical-domain behavior remain unverified. The publication script verifies emitted image PNGs while published and the page 404 after withdrawal; it does not fetch withdrawn image URLs or test sitemap/index convergence.

Client-approved case studies/artifacts remain absent. SQL exposes explicitly selected public fields behind is_public, but actual client approval and Board publication governance were not observed. Resume access disclosure was inspected, not hosted authorization or retention enforcement.
